title: [IMP2-17] Form of `ChannelAdmissionKey.relays` entries and the DM key response encoding are undefine
description: Review finding IMP2-17: Form of `ChannelAdmissionKey.relays` entries and the DM key response encoding are undefined (lens IMP2). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:291-295, :313; spec/04-access-control.md:150; spec/10-relays.md:525. Fix: Apply the reviewer's text. Each entry is a Relay manifest origin, with endpoints read from §10.2.1. The DM host returns the `application/cbor` envelope with `sig` absent, using the status codes of 03:313. Without the second sentence, 03:313's "with `sig` present" reads as applying to DM hosts too. Full text: notes/review2/IMP2-verified.md and notes/review2/IMP2.md.
